# (PART) Resources {-}

# Tree Data Dictionary {#tree-data-dictionary}

This page covers every column  used with ForestPlots tree data.
Use the **search box** to find any column by name or keyword, or use the **filter arrows**
on any column heading to narrow by template, requirement level, or units.

The **Required** column uses four categories:

* **Always** — must be filled in for every row in that template.
* **Conditional** — required only when a specific condition is met (see the *Condition* column).
* **Optional** — may be left blank.
* **Dry Forest** — only relevant for Dry Forest plots; leave blank otherwise.

See the [Common Issues and Frequently Asked Questions](#faq) for more information.

```{r tree-data-dictionary-setup, include=FALSE}
library(DT)
library(readxl)
```

```{r tree-data-dictionary-table, echo=FALSE}

# ── Data dictionary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Columns: Column | Template | Units | Description | Required | Condition | Format | Notes

dict <- read_excel(here::here("data/data-dictionary.xlsx"), sheet = "trees")
  

# ── Rendering ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
required_colours <- c(
  "Always"  = "#C8E6C9",   # soft green
  "Conditional" = "#FFF9C4",   # soft yellow
  "Optional" = "#E0E0E0",   # soft grey
  "Dry Forest"  = "#BBDEFB" # soft blue
)

datatable(
  dict,
  extensions = c("Buttons", "FixedHeader"),
  filter = "top",
  rownames  = FALSE,
  escape = FALSE,
  class = "compact stripe hover",
  options = list(
  pageLength  = 60,
  dom         = "Blfti",
  fixedHeader = TRUE,
  scrollX     = TRUE,
  buttons     = list(
    list(extend = "csv",    text = "Download CSV"),
    list(extend = "excel",  text = "Download Excel"),
    list(extend = "colvis", text = "Show / hide columns")
  ),
  autoWidth   = FALSE,
  columnDefs  = list(
    list(width = "160px", targets = 0),
    list(width = "45px",  targets = 1),
    list(width = "260px", targets = 2),
    list(width = "95px",  targets = 3),
    list(width = "220px", targets = 4),
    list(width = "200px", targets = 5),
    list(width = "220px", targets = 6),
    list(className = "dt-center", targets = c(1, 3)),
    list(targets = c(2, 4, 5, 6), className = "dt-wrap")
  ),
  language = list(
    search      = "Search all columns:",
    zeroRecords = "No columns match your search."
  )
)
) |>
  formatStyle(
 "Required",
 backgroundColor = styleEqual(names(required_colours), unname(required_colours)),
 fontWeight = "bold"
  ) |>
  formatStyle(
 "Condition",
 color = styleEqual(NA, "#BBBBBB")
  )
```
